title: A zero-one law for one-shot system identification
abstract: arXiv:2607.15832v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Can a model be identified from one experiment? We study analytic systems that are linearly parameterized by a combination of prescribed dictionary terms, such as partial differential operators and dynamical systems. For a single input-response pair, recovery is possible exactly when the evaluated dictionary terms are linearly independent. We prove a sharp zero-one law: either no input uniquely determines the coefficients, or almost every random input sampled from a nondegenerate Gaussian measure does. This dichotomy reduces one-shot system identification to a question about degenerate inputs and provides an a posteriori certificate in the noiseless setting. Numerical examples recover dynamical systems, nonlinear partial differential equations, and structured matrix families from single trajectory data, while also detecting when an extra probe is necessary.

translated_title: 一次性系统辨识的零一律
translated_abstract: 一个模型能否通过一次实验被辨识出来？我们研究了由一组预定字典项（如偏微分算子和动力系统）的组合进行线性参数化的解析系统。对于单个输入-响应对，当被求值的字典项线性无关时，恰好可以实现系统的精确恢复。我们证明了一个深刻的零一律：要么没有任何输入能唯一确定系数，要么几乎所有从非退化高斯测度中采样得到的随机输入都能做到。这一二分性将一次性系统辨识问题归结为关于退化输入的问题，并在无噪声情形下提供了事后验证证书。数值实验表明，可以从单条轨迹数据中恢复动力系统、非线性偏微分方程和结构化矩阵族，同时还能检测出何时需要额外的探测输入。
tldr: 该论文证明了一次性系统辨识的零一律：当字典项线性无关时，几乎所有从非退化高斯测度采样的随机输入都能唯一确定模型系数，否则没有任何输入可以做到，从而将单次实验辨识问题归结为退化输入的判定问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proves a sharp zero-one law for one-shot system identification: when the evaluated dictionary terms are linearly independent, almost every random input from a nondegenerate Gaussian measure uniquely determines the model coefficients, while otherwise no input can, reducing one-shot identification to a question about degenerate inputs.
